overal.goal: bin/src/service-cli.ts rebuilds the unit from the current argv only. The runbook's upgrade step is `service install --data $BOOF_DATA`, which silently drops a previous --env-file, --env, --port, --host and the recorded PATH, so agents start failing after upgrades. Persist the last install's options (sidecar JSON in the data root or a comment in the unit) and reuse them when flags are omitted; print what changed. Acceptance: test installs with --env-file, reinstalls with only --data, and the EnvironmentFile line survives.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Identified during the 2026-10-27 review; not started.

buildUnit records the install options as a "# boof-runner-options: {json}" comment line; install() reads the installed unit and reuses every omitted option (flag > previous > env var > default; --env merged per key, --env-file kept and re-checked, PATH = this shell's entries then the previous ones; node and CLI paths always current), prints one line per option (kept / old -> new / new) and --reset starts over; the unit is written 0600 because it records --env values, and the report never prints values; the acceptance test installs with --env-file, reinstalls with only --data and the EnvironmentFile line survives.

tests.strategy: Unit tests with vitest for the changed module; an integration test through the Hono app or CLI where the behaviour is observable there.
